name: Chas. S. Fee
role: Northern Pacific general passenger agent; publisher of 'Wonderland'
bio: Chas. S. Fee was the Northern Pacific's general passenger agent, credited in August 1884, with Footner, with signing contracts that gave Medora exclusive control of the Black Hills business of their departments, and expected on the first coach to the Black Hills. He published 'Wonderland,' which the Cow Boy received in 1885 and quoted on the Bad Lands in 1886.

moments.label: Signed contracts favoring the Medora route
